source.name: City of Chicago Data Portal, Building Permits
source.modified: Filtered by ProofNotFluff: permits issued in the last 24 months, new construction or renovation, reported cost $500,000 or more, still open (City status Active or Phased Permitting; complete, suspended, cancelled, revoked and expired permits left out), apartment buildings of 4+ units or commercial work, with a business listed as general contractor; work that never needs a construction clean under its permit (foundation, superstructure, caisson, demolition, roof, facade, mechanical, equipment or site work only) left out; cleaning companies listed as contractor left out; a revision of a permit already on the list counted once; only project-level and business fields kept.
